title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Per-Container Cap on CargoCare Settlements
content:
Each CargoCare product of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` limits what it pays for the one container a claim concerns.

## Definition

The **CargoCare amount** for a claim is what remains of the loss basis once the single deductible is taken off, never less than 0.00, and never more than the tier's cover cap per container. When the cap is what holds the amount down, the cap is said to bind.

| Tier | Cover cap per container (USD) |
|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0.00 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 0.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 50000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 100000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 250000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 500000.00 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical remainders after the deductible)

| Tier | Remainder after the deductible (USD) | CargoCare amount (USD) | Cap binds? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 59500.00 | 50000.00 | yes |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 50000.00 | 50000.00 | the remainder already equals the cap |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 7820.00 | 7820.00 | no |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | minus 120.00 | 0.00 | no; the amount stops at zero |

A remainder falls below zero when the deductible exceeds the loss basis; the CargoCare amount then stays at 0.00.
